result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order report now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The code compiles, but I didn't run any tests, and no existing test references `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep`.

In `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep`, the count subquery now has `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`. This is the same filter the quarterly and weekday purchase-order reports use. Reps with no purchase orders are still listed with 0, and the sort order is unchanged. I also updated the method's Javadoc to say cancelled orders are excluded.
